blocks.md: This lesson covers the book's section on **Incident Containment**. Read the excerpt, then test yourself below.

blocks.source: Vol III, Failure Recovery, § Incident Containment
blocks.md: Suppose the automated repair agent attempts to send private test fixture data through an external package-search tool. The disclosure gate rejects the invocation before dispatch and places the trajectory on hold, shifting the runtime's problem from protecting a failing dependency to protecting every downstream system, shared memory store, and artifact pipeline that the suspect trajectory has touched or might touch next. The immediate systems challenge is determining what may safely proceed while the control plane assesses the affected state.

blocks.title: What the section covers
blocks.md:
In the book this section runs through:

- Holds on model-directed work
- Affected artifacts
- Residual settlement

blocks.prompt: Think first: In two or three sentences, explain why Incident containment matters for the system this section describes.
blocks.md: Compare your answer with the book's claim: On suspicion, fail-safe defaults hold the trajectory at every dispatch boundary without the agent's cooperation while preregistered cleanup runs under a separate narrow grant until residual obligations settle.

questions.q: The section **Incident Containment** develops one of the chapter's claims. Which one?
options: A trajectory saga durably registers each effectful step's cleanup template before dispatch, not after the step returns, so a crash never leaves an effect without its compensator.

A looping trajectory is hyperactive, not dead, so a watchdog compares a declared task projection, verifier results, and repeated action-outcome pairs over a bounded window, and its window sets detection latency.
Transport retry, fresh proposal, feedback repair, compensation, and hold or escalate are chosen by evidence class first, then admission, then expected cost.

On suspicion, fail-safe defaults hold the trajectory at every dispatch boundary without the agent's cooperation while preregistered cleanup runs under a separate narrow grant until residual obligations settle.
